sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 per unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. We acknowledge your increased demand forecast and past order history. However, current market conditions and our operational costs require us to adjust our pricing. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. We can offer €4.94 per unit to accommodate your requested 24-month contract and 90-day payment terms. Our current Angebot features a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

decisions.tactician: E0 and o6 give the same lowest C (€168,245); the 12-month options leave C around €182,800. The supplier values multi-year volume, so a 24-month term gives it something real. Choosing 24 rather than E0's 36 months keeps our flexibility while delivering the same C. The volume-growth and order-history arguments back a low anchor near €4.39. The weak on-time record (a1) is left out so the owner's fact-based tone isn't soured in an early round.

decisions.tactician: o4 has nearly the lowest C (€176,970, essentially level with E0 and o3). It adds the 36-month term this supplier strongly values. That extra value is not counted in the -10.2 % figure, so the sheet is more attractive to it than the number suggests. Moving to sixty-day payment also costs it less cash than ninety days. Citing the 85 % delivery record is a fresh argument kind that adds pressure. Accepting €4.94 now would leave large savings behind, and with nine messages left we have room to keep pushing.

decisions.tactician: E0 keeps the 36-month term and 60-day payment the supplier itself put on its sheet, which serves its planning-security need, and it costs us about €14k less than accepting offer:70620-2. o2 would save us only a trivial amount more, but adding 90-day payment on top of 36 months stacks another ask and may stall the counter. Shorter contracts work against its volume need. Its status is still open with eight messages left, so pushing is low risk, and taking its current sheet now would leave value on the table.
